home.hero_title: Focused tools. One problem at a time.
home.hero_lede: Acorn Juice Solutions is a studio founded by two partners with extensive experience in software development and infrastructure implementation, based in Navarra, Spain. We build scalable, well-crafted software — from utilities and widgets to mobile apps, websites, APIs, pipelines and cloud infrastructure — that solves real problems for real people and teams.
home.products_lede: A mix of commercial products and free utilities. Carefully maintained and monitored.
home.makers_lede: Every product gets personal attention and reflects the work of the team behind it.
home.approach_lede: Every product and every engagement — commercial or not — follows the same five principles.

approach.craft_body: Code review, tests (unit, integration and E2E), documented conventions and CI that fails loud. Nothing ships that we would not be comfortable handing off to a senior partner.
approach.patterns_body: Design patterns and architectural choices with a track record. We reach for the well-understood solution first, and only consider the clever one when it truly fits.
approach.security_body: Input validation at trust boundaries, secrets kept out of the repo, principle of least privilege, auditable dependencies. Built in from the first commit, not bolted on before release.
approach.iterative_body: We work in short cycles: sprint planning, incremental delivery and client review every iteration. Adjusting early is cheaper than fixing later.
approach.efficiency_body: We take time seriously: short, agenda-driven meetings, automation for anything that repeats, and focus on the work that adds value. Less noise, more outcome.

home.services_lede: Beyond our own products, we also work with teams as an extension of theirs. A short, honest list of what we can take on:

services.cloud_body: From on-prem or legacy environments to well-architected cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS or Google Cloud. Migration planning, cost modelling, and hands-on execution.
services.pipelines_body: Analysis and definition of build, test and release pipelines applying modern best practices — reproducible builds, gated releases, secret hygiene and rollout safety by default.
services.fullstack_body: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Angular. Backend services, APIs, front-ends and the database work that ties them together. Comfortable across stacks and legacy code.
services.infra_body: DevOps automation, environment provisioning, monitoring and networking — including Mikrotik router configuration for on-prem or hybrid setups.
services.training_body: Technical training for developer teams (best practices, security, CI/CD, cloud) and digital-competencies sessions for non-technical staff. Sessions in Spanish or English, remote or on-site, tailored to the team's starting level.

home.contact_lede: Have a question, an idea, or a project you want us to look at? Drop us a line.

about.title: About Acorn Juice Solutions
about.lede: Independent software studio from Navarra, Spain. Our team brings complementary skills and puts quality over quantity: we prefer to build less, well-crafted, rather than ship in bulk.
about.experience_body: Over 25 years delivering custom software for clients in demanding sectors: international banking, public sector, industry, construction and more. We work fluently in English and have collaborated with international teams across Europe — engagements can run in English or Spanish. Domains we've worked in:
about.experience_approach: We apply the quality and security practices we learned delivering software for banks and large accounts to every project — from a focused utility to a scalable platform. We work with agile methodologies, sprint by sprint. The scale changes; the rigor doesn't.
about.experience_note: Client names are withheld under confidentiality agreements. Verifiable details on the makers' LinkedIn profiles.
